transcript: Speaker A: तीन साल से एक ही पोस्ट पर अटका हूँ। सिर्फ इसलिए क्योंकि इंग्लिश से डर लगता है। [I have been stuck in the same post for three years just because I am afraid of English.]... Speaker B: भैया कब तक मुझसे लिखवाओगे? काम तो तुम्हें सबसे अच्छा आता है, बस इंग्लिश की कमी है। [Brother, how long will you make me write? You know the work best, only English is lacking.]... Speaker A: इंग्लिश सीखो, डाउनलोड करो और एक रुपये के ट्रायल से शुरू करो। [Learn English, download now and start with a one-rupee trial.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, AI Coach Disha, Install Now, Disclaimer
summary: An animated salesman struggles with career growth due to his fear of English, relying on his sister to reply to work messages. After she recommends the English Seekho app, he practices with its AI coach, gains confidence, and secures a high-paying job. The ad promotes downloading the app for a 1-rupee trial.
